_doc: Which vendor each integration category is bound to in this repo. scripts/wire_integration.py edits it; scripts/lint.py renders it into integrations/README.md and checks that .mcp.json agrees. Skills name a category in metadata.needs; this file says which vendor fills it here. custom_servers lists .mcp.json servers that are not in the catalog, each with a one-line reason.

tasks.note: in-repo checklists, the fallback in integrations/tasks.md; /setup binds the team's tool
